title: The President, the Postal Service and the Election

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯《Dealbook》的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，其中包括万斯、

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The president, the postal service, and the election.
sentences.zh: 总统、邮政局与选举。

sentences.en: My colleague, Luke Broadwater, on What's Actually Going On.
sentences.zh: 我的同事卢克·布罗德沃特将为您解读实际情况。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, August 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月19日，星期三。

sentences.en: Luke, there's a theory floating out there about the post office, the president, and the upcoming election.
sentences.zh: 卢克，现在流传着一种关于邮局、总统和即将到来的选举的说法。

sentences.en: I wonder if you can just explain it.
sentences.zh: 我想请你解释一下。

sentences.en: What is this theory?
sentences.zh: 这到底是什么说法？

sentences.en: So the theory, I guess the short version of it is this.
sentences.zh: 这个说法的简短版本大概是这样的。

sentences.en: President Trump has installed a mega-donor and close ally as the postmaster general and has set him about on a course to cut the post office
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统任命了一位巨额捐款人和亲密盟友担任邮政局长，并让他着手削减邮局经费，

sentences.en: and in doing so wreak havoc onto mail-in voting, thereby helping President Trump be reelected.
sentences.zh: 从而对邮寄投票造成混乱，进而帮助特朗普总统连任。

sentences.en: And look, where does this theory come from?
sentences.zh: 听着，这种说法是从哪里来的呢？

sentences.en: Well, we can take it all the way back to about the turn of the century when mail-use peaks in America right around 2001.
sentences.zh: 我们可以追溯到世纪之交左右，当时美国的邮件使用量在2001年左右达到峰值。

sentences.en: And since that time, we've seen about a 50% reduction in the mailing of first-class mail.
sentences.zh: 自那时起，我们看到头等舱邮件的寄送量减少了大约50%。

sentences.en: To accommodate this, a series of postmaster generals have approved cuts and reductions to things like mailboxes to things like sorting machines
sentences.zh: 为了适应这一变化，历任邮政局长都批准了对邮箱和分拣机等设施的削减和缩减，

sentences.en: in an attempt to shrink the agency along with the lower volume of mail.
sentences.zh: 试图随着邮件数量的减少来缩减机构规模。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Then you have this pandemic come in, and you have a ton of people now and a ton of states looking at mail-in balloting.
sentences.zh: 接着这场大流行病爆发了，现在有大量的人和许多州都在考虑邮寄投票。

sentences.en: Something like three out of four Americans may be eligible to vote by mail this year.
sentences.zh: 大约四分之三的美国人今年可能有资格通过邮寄方式投票。

sentences.en: And so you have this whole new demand on the post office.
sentences.zh: 因此，邮局面临着全新的需求。

sentences.en: Then, on top of all these problems, a new postmaster general is installed.
sentences.zh: 然后，在所有这些问题之上，新任邮政局长上任了。

sentences.en: His postmaster general is a Republican mega-donor who, 85 days from the election, by the way, decided the time was right for a chaotic and sweeping overhaul.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这位邮政局长是一位共和党巨额捐款人，在距离大选还有85天的时候，他认为进行混乱而彻底的改革的时机已经成熟。

sentences.en: His name is Louis DeJoy.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫路易斯·德约伊。

sentences.en: He has never worked for the post office before.
sentences.zh: 他以前从未在邮局工作过。

sentences.en: Critics of the president say he's trying to sabotage the postal service ahead of the election.
sentences.zh: 总统的批评者称，他试图在大选前破坏邮政服务。

sentences.en: It was only a month and a half ago Trump identified mail-in voting as the biggest threat to a second term.
sentences.zh: 就在一个半月前，特朗普还将邮寄投票指为连任的最大威胁。

sentences.en: He reassigns more than 20 executives in the post office.
sentences.zh: 他重新调配了邮局的20多名高管。

sentences.en: He immediately limits overtime for the postal workers.
sentences.zh: 他立即限制了邮政工人的加班时间。

sentences.en: In the union's view, he speeds up the removal of mail-sorting machines.
sentences.zh: 在工会看来，他加快了拆除邮件分拣机的速度。

sentences.en: He puts in stringent rules that limit how many times a mail carrier can make a run in a day.
sentences.zh: 他制定了严格的规则，限制邮递员一天的出车次数。

sentences.en: And the result of all these changes, where some people were seeing slower mail, becomes, in many people's view, a crisis.
sentences.zh: 所有这些变化的结果是，一些人发现邮件变慢了，在许多人看来，这变成了一场危机。

sentences.en: People all across the country are calling their senators, calling their congresspeople.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的人们都在给他们的参议员和国会议员打电话。

sentences.en: They are saying they haven't gotten mail for weeks.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们已经好几周没收到信件了。

sentences.en: I talked with one congressperson in Philadelphia who said in a normal July, he gets something like 10 to 20 complaints about the post office.
sentences.zh: 我与费城的一位国会议员交谈过，他说在正常的七月份，他大约会收到10到20起关于邮局的投诉。

sentences.en: And this year in July, he got more than 300 and was 400.
sentences.zh: 而今年七月，他收到了300多起，甚至达到了400起。

sentences.en: And so people who were already worried about DeJoy and what he was doing at the post office, their fears were exacerbated when last week.
sentences.zh: 因此，那些本来就担心德约伊及其在邮局所作所为的人，他们的担忧在上周进一步加剧了。

sentences.en: But two of the items are the post office and the three and a half billion dollars for mail-in voting.
sentences.zh: 其中两个项目是邮局以及用于邮寄投票的35亿美元。

sentences.en: Now, if we don't make a deal, that means they don't get the money.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果我们达不成协议，就意味着他们拿不到这笔资金。

sentences.en: That means they can't have universal mail-in voting.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们无法实行全民邮寄投票。

sentences.en: They just can't have it.
sentences.zh: 他们就是无法实行。

sentences.en: President Trump came out and basically admitted that he doesn't want to fund certain aspects of the post office because they might contribute to mail-in voting.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统公开表示，他基本上不想资助邮局的某些方面，因为它们可能会促成邮寄投票。

sentences.en: And when he said that, it was like alarm bells rang across the country for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 当他说出这句话时，犹如全美各地的民主党人敲响了警报。

sentences.en: What is the president objecting to here exactly?
sentences.zh: 总统在这里具体反对的是什么？

sentences.en: What is his problem with this funding?
sentences.zh: 他对这笔资金有什么意见？

sentences.en: And what is this funding?
sentences.zh: 这笔资金又是做什么用的？

sentences.en: So this all comes out of the fight over the latest round of stimulus legislation to help Americans suffering from the coronavirus and to help the American economy.
sentences.zh: 这一切都源于关于最新一轮刺激立法方案的争论，该方案旨在帮助受冠状病毒困扰的美国人并帮助美国经济。

sentences.en: In the Democrats' proposal, they have $25 billion to help the post office, and they have $3.6 billion to help states with their elections.
sentences.zh: 在民主党人的提案中，他们有250亿美元用于帮助邮局，还有36亿美元用于帮助各州进行选举。

sentences.en: There is a provision in the Democrats' bill for universal mail-in voting, but that is not directly connected to the money for the post office.
sentences.zh: 民主党人的法案中有一项关于全民邮寄投票的条款，但这与邮局的资金没有直接联系。

sentences.en: It appears that President Trump has conflated these two issues, so he thinks that by blocking the money for the post office, he's preventing universal mail-in voting.
sentences.zh: 看来特朗普总统混淆了这两个问题，所以他认为通过阻止邮局的资金，他就能阻止全民邮寄投票。

sentences.en: The truth is that states have already decided on their own whether or not they're doing universal mail-in voting, and this money for the post office would not change that.
sentences.zh: 事实是，各州已经自行决定是否实行全民邮寄投票，而这笔给邮局的资金不会改变这一点。

sentences.en: So in the process of opposing this thing that's not really even in the Democrats' proposals,
sentences.zh: 因此，在反对这个甚至根本不在民主党提案中的事情的过程中，

sentences.en: he's nevertheless admitting very explicitly that he wants to find a way to curtail mail-in voting by depriving the Postal Service of funding.
sentences.zh: 他却非常明确地承认，他希望通过剥夺邮政服务的资金来找到限制邮寄投票的方法。

sentences.en: Yes, he says that out loud, and you could hear jaws hitting the floor around the country.
sentences.zh: 是的，他大声说出了这一点，你可以听到全国各地惊掉下巴的声音。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But to make matters worse, right around this time,
sentences.zh: 但更糟糕的是，正是在这个时候，

sentences.en: you start seeing reports come out from different states across the country that they have received letters from the Postal Service saying we might not be able to accommodate mail-in balloting in the final weeks of the election for your state.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到全国各州有报道称，他们收到了邮政服务局的信件，称我们可能无法在你们州大选的最后几周适应邮寄投票。

sentences.en: And so with Trump's comments,
sentences.zh: 因此，结合特朗普的言论，

sentences.en: then these letters and everything else we know about Postmaster General DeJoy and his background and ties to the Republican Party and the cuts he's putting in place,
sentences.zh: 然后是这些信件以及我们所知道的关于邮政局长德约伊及其背景、与共和党的关系以及他正在实施的削减措施的一切，

sentences.en: people around the country start to suspect that there's sabotage going on.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的人们开始怀疑是否存在蓄意破坏。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So here you're laying out the kind of elements of this theory that now, I'm sure for many people, especially Democrats, is starting to sound not so much like a theory,
sentences.zh: 所以你在这里阐述了这种说法的各种要素，现在，我确信对许多人尤其是民主党人来说，这听起来与其说是一种说法，

sentences.en: but a kind of reality.
sentences.zh: 不如说是一种现实。

sentences.en: And so I'm curious how people within the Democratic Party are reacting exactly.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇民主党内部的人士究竟作何反应。

sentences.en: What are they saying?
sentences.zh: 他们在说些什么？

sentences.en: What are they doing?
sentences.zh: 他们在做些什么？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, it was immediate outrage.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是立即引发了愤怒。

sentences.en: People started protesting.
sentences.zh: 人们开始抗议。

sentences.en: People went to Postmaster General DeJoy's house and protested outside his house.
sentences.zh: 人们去了邮政局长德约伊的家，在他的房子外面抗议。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi, Speaker Pelosi,
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西，众议院议长佩洛西，

sentences.en: has called the House to come back and pass emergency legislation to block what Postmaster General DeJoy and President Trump are doing to the post office, in her view.
sentences.zh: 已呼吁众议院返回并通过紧急立法，在她看来，以阻止邮政局长德约伊和特朗普总统对邮局所做的事情。

sentences.en: And you see a hearing on Monday,
sentences.zh: 你看到周一将举行一场听证会，

sentences.en: an emergency hearing in which Mr. DeJoy will be called in front of Congress to take tough questions about his role in all this and what his plans and intentions are.
sentences.zh: 一场紧急听证会，德约伊先生将被传唤到国会面前，就他在这一切中所扮演的角色以及他的计划和意图接受严厉质询。

sentences.en: So the president's comments, essentially confirming many people's fears, have poured a lot of fuel onto this theory.
sentences.zh: 因此，总统的言论实质上证实了许多人的恐惧，为这种说法火上浇油。

sentences.en: But as plausible as this theory may sound,
sentences.zh: 但尽管这种说法听起来很合理，

sentences.en: is there actual evidence that connects DeJoy's actions to Donald Trump and shows that he's actively seeking to undermine the Postal Service to strengthen his chances of re-election?
sentences.zh: 是否有实际证据将德约伊的行动与唐纳德·特朗普联系起来，并表明他积极寻求破坏邮政服务以增加他连任的机会？

sentences.en: I mean, he has said that, but in terms of actual actions, I don't think you can say that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他确实说过那些话，但就实际行动而言，我认为你不能这么说。

sentences.en: To pull that off, you would have to destroy the post office in key areas, right?
sentences.zh: 要做到这一点，你必须在关键地区摧毁邮局，对吧？

sentences.en: You would have to do it in Democratic strongholds, but not in rural areas.
sentences.zh: 你必须在民主党的票仓这样做，而不是在农村地区。

sentences.en: You would have to be very sort of selective about how you went about cutting and weakening the post office.
sentences.zh: 你必须对如何削减和削弱邮局有选择性。

sentences.en: And that's not really what we've seen.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是我们真正看到的。

sentences.en: What we've seen is across the country, we've seen problems with the post office.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是在全国范围内，我们看到了邮局的问题。

sentences.en: In fact, a lot of the complaints that we get are from rural Americans, and we see a lot of rural Republicans who are very upset about what's going on at the post office.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们得到的很多投诉都来自美国农村，我们看到很多农村的共和党人对邮局正在发生的事情非常不满。

sentences.en: GOP senators and Republican secretaries of state.
sentences.zh: 共和党参议员和共和党州务卿。

sentences.en: So Donald Trump believes that mail-in voting helps Democrats, but almost all the studies we've seen is that it doesn't really help anybody.
sentences.zh: 因此，唐纳德·特朗普认为邮寄投票对民主党有利，但几乎我们看到的所有研究都表明，它对任何人都没有真正的好处。

sentences.en: It just makes more people vote.
sentences.zh: 它只是让更多的人投票。

sentences.en: Now, maybe he views it as if fewer people vote, I can win.
sentences.zh: 现在，也许他认为如果投票的人少一些，他就能赢。

sentences.en: But there's no real evidence of that either, that sort of a smaller electorate would benefit him over Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 但也没有真实的证据表明这一点，即较小的选民群体会比乔·拜登对他更有利。

sentences.en: Well, now that they've seen this reaction to the president's words and this theory has taken hold, how is the Trump administration responding?
sentences.zh: 现在他们看到了对总统言论的这种反应，并且这种说法已经站稳脚跟，特朗普政府作何回应？

sentences.en: Well, they've walked back a number of things that Trump said.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们收回了特朗普所说的一些话。

sentences.en: If the Democrats were to give you some of what you want, which you articulated in a series of tweets in the last hour,
sentences.zh: 如果民主党人给你一些你想要的东西，你在过去一小时的一系列推文中阐述了这一点，

sentences.en: would you be willing to accept the $25 billion for the Postal Service, including the $3.5 billion?
sentences.zh: 你是否愿意接受用于邮政服务的250亿美元，包括35亿美元？

sentences.en: Sure, they gave us what we want.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们给了我们想要的。

sentences.en: And it's not what I want, it's what the American people want.
sentences.zh: 这不是我想要的，这是美国人民想要的。

sentences.en: The president has now said he's open to funding the post office in a way that he wasn't only a day earlier.
sentences.zh: 总统现在表示，他愿意以一天前所没有的方式资助邮局。

sentences.en: His chief of staff, Mark Meadows, has gone out there and said...
sentences.zh: 他的幕僚长马克·梅多斯已经公开表示……

sentences.en: I'm all about piecemeal.
sentences.zh: 我全心支持逐项解决。

sentences.en: If we can agree on postal, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能在邮政问题上达成一致，那就干吧。

sentences.en: That they would be open to a standalone bill to fund the post office.
sentences.zh: 他们将对一项资助邮局的独立法案持开放态度。

sentences.en: I've been the one that's advocating for that.
sentences.zh: 我一直是主张这一点的。

sentences.en: Speaker Pelosi is the one who says that she won't do anything unless it's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西议长则表示，除非是一笔大交易，否则她什么也不做。

sentences.en: They've made a number of pledges to try to tamp down some of the accusations.
sentences.zh: 他们做出了一系列承诺，试图平息一些指责。

sentences.en: There's no sorting machines that are going offline between now and the election.
sentences.zh: 在现在到大选之间，没有任何分拣机会下线。

sentences.en: That's not happening.
sentences.zh: 那不会发生。

sentences.en: They've said they'll stop removing the post boxes.
sentences.zh: 他们已经表示将停止拆除邮箱。

sentences.en: They said they have authorized overtime for the election.
sentences.zh: 他们表示已经批准了选举期间的加班。

sentences.en: And the postmaster general has pledged that every ballot will be treated with respect and counted and sent to the proper place.
sentences.zh: 邮政局长承诺，每一张选票都将得到尊重、清点并送往正确的地方。

sentences.en: They are pledging up and down.
sentences.zh: 他们信誓旦旦地做出保证。

sentences.en: There won't be any sabotage.
sentences.zh: 不会有任何蓄意破坏。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So at this point, the Trump administration has more or less said we will stop doing the things that are fueling this theory that's now very much out there,
sentences.zh: 因此，在这一点上，特朗普政府多多少少表示我们将停止做那些煽动这种目前大肆流行的说法的行为，

sentences.en: that we are trying to damage the Postal Service to try to win a second term in the middle of a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 即我们正试图在大流行期间破坏邮政服务以试图赢得第二个任期。

sentences.en: I'm curious what the actual capacity of the Postal Service is with the cuts that are already in place.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇在已经到位的削减措施下，邮政服务的实际能力如何。

sentences.en: You know, can the Postal Service handle an election in which 100 to 200 million people may use mail-in ballots?
sentences.zh: 你知道，邮政服务能否应付一场可能有1亿到2亿人使用邮寄选票的选举？

sentences.en: The short answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，可以。

sentences.en: They have more than enough capacity to handle that volume of mail.
sentences.zh: 他们有足够的能力处理那个体量的邮件。

sentences.en: Pretty much everybody agrees on that.
sentences.zh: 几乎每个人都对此达成共识。

sentences.en: Election experts, the Postal Union, the Postmaster General.
sentences.zh: 选举专家、邮政工会、邮政局长。

sentences.en: If you look at a traditional Christmas time, you have much more mail moving than you're going to see during this election,
sentences.zh: 如果你看看传统的圣诞节期间，你所流动的邮件要比你在这次选举中看到的要多得多，

sentences.en: even though it is a very heightened amount of mail-in ballots.
sentences.zh: 尽管邮寄选票的数量确实非常高。

sentences.en: The issue for the Post Office is not the volume or the capacity.
sentences.zh: 邮局的问题不在于体量或能力。

sentences.en: The issue is the timing.
sentences.zh: 问题在于时间。

sentences.en: And so they have a concern about last-minute requests for mail-in ballots.
sentences.zh: 因此他们对最后关头索取邮寄选票的请求感到担忧。

sentences.en: That's really their issue.
sentences.zh: 这才是他们真正的问题。

sentences.en: There's 45 states across the country that allow people to request ballots within two weeks before the election.
sentences.zh: 全美有45个州允许人们在选举前两周内索取选票。

sentences.en: Some allow the requests as short as four days.
sentences.zh: 有些州允许申请的时间短至四天。

sentences.en: There are even five states that will send out a mail-in ballot to a voter if they receive an application by mail even the day before the election.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有五个州，如果选民在选举前一天甚至通过邮件收到申请，就会向其寄出邮寄选票。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's just not a lot of time for the Postal Service to get a ballot out, get a person to fill it out, and get it back in time before the election.
sentences.zh: 对于邮政服务来说，这实在是没有多少时间将选票送出、让选民填好并在选举前及时送回。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: So the Postal Service is saying even in a good year, even a year where there's not this big rush of mail-in ballots and there's no pandemic,
sentences.zh: 所以邮政局说，即便是在一个好年景，在一个没有这种邮寄选票大抢购也没有大流行病的年景，

sentences.en: we would have trouble with some of those deadlines.
sentences.zh: 我们在其中一些截止日期前也会遇到麻烦。

sentences.en: And so we're asking you in a pandemic year, in a year where 75% of voters are eligible to vote by mail,
sentences.zh: 因此，在一个大流行病之年，在一个75%的选民有资格通过邮寄投票的年份，我们请求你们

sentences.en: please push your deadlines back and give us two weeks to process these things.
sentences.zh: 请把你们的截止日期往后推两周，给我们两周时间来处理这些事情。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: They're just basically creating a bigger buffer of time to make sure they can handle all of his capacity.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上只是在创造一个更大的时间缓冲，以确保能够处理他所有的运力。

sentences.en: That seems kind of reasonable.
sentences.zh: 这听起来挺合理的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, and I think that if this request had gone out without Donald Trump's comments, without Postmaster General DeJoy's cuts,
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，我认为如果这个请求在没有唐纳德·特朗普的评论、没有邮政局长德乔伊的削减措施之前发出去的话，

sentences.en: they would have been seen as a sort of a reasonable letter to ensure that everyone's vote actually counted.
sentences.zh: 它会被视为一封合理的信件，以确保每个人的选票都能真正被计算在内。

sentences.en: That the Post Office can't accommodate some of these deadlines, well,
sentences.zh: 如果邮局无法适应其中的某些截止日期，那么，

sentences.en: let's change them to make sure that no one is under a false impression that they're filling out a ballot that's going to count when it's not actually going to get there in time.
sentences.zh: 让我们改变它们，以确保没有人抱有虚假的印象，以为他们在填写一张最终无法按时送达而无法计入的选票。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So look, I want to return to the original theory here about the president, the Postal Service, and the election.
sentences.zh: 所以，听着，我想回到最初关于总统、邮政服务和选举的理论上来。

sentences.en: You identified the ways in which the president could, if he wanted to, weaken the Postal Service in ways that would advantage him in the election by, for example,
sentences.zh: 你指出了总统如果愿意的话，可以通过哪些方式削弱邮政服务，从而在选举中为自己谋取利益，例如，

sentences.en: going into a democratic community and making cuts to the Postal Service.
sentences.zh: 进入民主党社区并削减邮政服务。

sentences.en: Does the president actually have that kind of power?
sentences.zh: 总统真的有那种权力吗？

sentences.en: Could he demand changes to the Postal Service in the next 70 or 80 days that would actually make it easier for him to win re-election?
sentences.zh: 他能在接下来的 70 或 80 天里要求对邮政服务进行更改，从而实际上让他更容易赢得连任吗？

sentences.en: Well, so he does control the board of governors now for the Postal Service, and he controls the Postmaster General.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他现在确实控制着邮政服务的理事会，并且他控制着邮政局长。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And he could give them some marching orders, theoretically.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，他可以给他们下达一些明确的指令。

sentences.en: That said, I do think it would be difficult to carry out without raising the alarm of a large unionized workforce.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我确实认为这很难执行，不会不引起庞大的工会化劳动力的警惕。

sentences.en: If all of a sudden the entire branch of the Philadelphia Post Office was closed down and people were laid off, we would know about that.
sentences.zh: 如果费城邮局的分支机构突然全部关闭，员工被解雇，我们是会知道的。

sentences.en: These are not shrinking violets who would just be pushed around.
sentences.zh: 这些人可不是那种会被随意摆布的软柿子。

sentences.en: So he either need buy-in from the unions to sabotage the election, a bunch of unionized workers, which seems highly unlikely,
sentences.zh: 因此，他要么需要得到工会对其破坏选举的默许（这涉及大量工会工人，这看起来极不可能），

sentences.en: or we would hear crying foul from every corner of the country about what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 否则我们会听到全国各个角落对他的所作所为发出抗议。

sentences.en: So you're saying it's not very practical as an electoral strategy for the president.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，作为总统的选举策略，这并不是很实际。

sentences.en: But I wonder if you're getting the sense that the president's actions so far and his words when it comes to the Postal Service and this election are creating a lot of doubt about whether mail-in voting is going to work and whether the Postal Service can make mail-in voting work.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道你是否有一种感觉，即总统迄今为止的行动以及他在邮政服务和这次选举方面的言论，正在引发人们对邮寄投票是否会奏效以及邮政服务是否能让邮寄投票奏效产生大量怀疑。

sentences.en: And if that is starting to, in its own way, undermine faith in the Postal Service in the minds of voters.
sentences.zh: 如果这开始以其自身的方式削弱选民心中对邮政服务的信心。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: It's an interesting thing the president's doing because the Post Office has long been one of the most popular functions of government.
sentences.zh: 这是总统正在做的一件有趣的事情，因为邮局长期以来一直是政府最受欢迎的职能部门之一。

sentences.en: I think 91% of Americans, Republicans and Democrats alike, support the Post Office.
sentences.zh: 我想 91% 的美国人，无论是共和党人还是民主党人，都支持邮局。

sentences.en: And so what the unions believe he's doing is they say there are three levels of support that they have.
sentences.zh: 因此，工会认为他正在做的是，他们说他们拥有三个层级的支持。

sentences.en: One is the Board of Governors.
sentences.zh: 一是理事会。

sentences.en: They say the president's taken that over.
sentences.zh: 他们说总统已经接管了那个机构。

sentences.en: The second is the Postmaster General.
sentences.zh: 二是邮政局长。

sentences.en: They say the president has taken that over.
sentences.zh: 他们说总统已经接管了那个职位。

sentences.en: And the third is the American public.
sentences.zh: 三是美国公众。

sentences.en: And they still have the American public on their side.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然拥有美国公众的支持。

sentences.en: But if the service of the Post Office is so eroded and the confidence in it has degraded so much that their polling starts to fall and people don't have confidence in them anymore,
sentences.zh: 但是，如果邮政服务的服务遭到如此严重的侵蚀，对其信心的打击如此之大，以至于他们的民调开始下降，人们不再对他们有信心，

sentences.en: well, now the theory goes it's open for privatization.
sentences.zh: 好吧，按照这种理论，这就为私有化敞开了大门。

sentences.en: Oh, interesting.
sentences.zh: 哦，有意思。

sentences.en: And what could be a bigger stage for people to judge the Postal Service than an election?
sentences.zh: 还有什么比选举更能成为人们评判邮政服务的盛大舞台呢？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There is the issue of voter fraud.
sentences.zh: 这里存在着选民欺诈的问题。

sentences.en: Isn't it amazing the way they say there's no voter fraud?
sentences.zh: 他们说不存在选民欺诈，这难道不是很惊人吗？

sentences.en: Donald Trump has long sought to undermine American elections with this rhetoric.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普长期以来一直试图利用这种言论来破坏美国选举。

sentences.en: There are 1.8 million dead people that are registered right now to vote.
sentences.zh: 目前登记投票的死者有 180 万人。

sentences.en: And folks, folks, some of them vote.
sentences.zh: 各位，各位，其中有些人还投票了。

sentences.en: I wonder why.
sentences.zh: 我想知道为什么。

sentences.en: I wonder how that happened.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是怎么发生的。

sentences.en: They woke up from the dead and they went and voted.
sentences.zh: 他们死而复生，然后去投票了。

sentences.en: But now what we're seeing is on the other side.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们看到的是另一面。

sentences.en: Within this administration is an attempt to make sure your vote doesn't count and doesn't count as caSt.
sentences.zh: 本届政府内部正试图确保你的选票不被计算在内，不被算作有效选票。

sentences.en: Democrats are worried about a rigged election.
sentences.zh: 民主党人担心选举被操纵。

sentences.en: The actions this administration are taking vis-a-vis our voting system, our sacred right to vote, are a domestic assault on our Constitution.
sentences.zh: 本届政府针对我们的投票系统、我们神圣的投票权所采取的行动，是对我们宪法的国内袭击。

sentences.en: Donald Trump is aimed at hurting the elections.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普旨在破坏选举。

sentences.en: He says he wants to slow down the mail to hurt the elections and make people doubt the results of the election.
sentences.zh: 他说他想放慢邮件速度以破坏选举，并让人们怀疑选举结果。

sentences.en: So now we're seeing both sides questioning the legitimacy of the election.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们看到双方都在质疑选举的合法性。

sentences.en: And I don't know how that's a good recipe for America and for confidence in our electoral system.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这怎么能成为对美国以及对我们选举系统信心的良方。

sentences.en: What we've never seen before is a president say, I'm going to try to actively kneecap the Postal Service.
sentences.zh: 我们以前从未见过一个总统说：“我要积极试图废掉邮政服务。”

sentences.en: And I will be explicit about the reason I'm doing it.
sentences.zh: 而且我会明确说出我这么做的原因。

sentences.en: That's sort of unheard of.
sentences.zh: 这简直闻所未闻。

sentences.en: You know, I can't help but think about 2016 and Russian interference.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不禁想起 2016 年和俄罗斯的干预。

sentences.en: And I'm kind of haunted by the Russian theory of the case, which is that you don't actually have to do the thing.
sentences.zh: 我一直挥之不去的是俄罗斯的案件理论，即你实际上不必做那件事。

sentences.en: You don't actually have to interfere on the election.
sentences.zh: 你实际上不必干预选举。

sentences.en: Because the real power is just in calling the election itself into doubt.
sentences.zh: 因为真正的力量在于对选举本身产生怀疑。

sentences.en: Oh, that's an interesting point.
sentences.zh: 哦，这是一个有趣的观点。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, the key distinction between the two is in 2016, a lot of the concern was about outside interference.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，两者之间的关键区别在于，在 2016 年，很多担忧都是关于外部干预。

sentences.en: This time, the accusation is that the meddling is coming from the White House itself, that the call is coming from inside the House, so to speak.
sentences.zh: 这一次，指控是干涉来自白宫本身，也就是俗话说的“内鬼就在其中”。

sentences.en: That is obviously a huge cause for alarm.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个引起严重警惕的原因。

sentences.en: And it's a very different line of concern than we saw in 2016.
sentences.zh: 这与我们在 2016 年看到的担忧路线截然不同。

sentences.en: Now, you know, despite all this concern and all the heated rhetoric that we've heard, there is perhaps a silver lining.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道，尽管有所有的担忧和我们听到的所有激烈言辞，可能还是有一线希望。

sentences.en: And that is when you talk with a lot of get out the vote folks and you talk with activists about how their messaging is changing.
sentences.zh: 那就是当你与许多动员选民的人交谈，并与活动人士讨论他们的信息传达是如何改变的时候。

sentences.en: Now they're really pushing this idea that you need to vote a good two weeks before the election by mail.
sentences.zh: 现在他们真的在力推这样一个观点：你需要通过邮件在选举前足足两周投票。

sentences.en: And so people that maybe didn't hear that message and would have voted the week before election and maybe the post office wouldn't have gotten the ballot there in time for their vote to count.
sentences.zh: 因此，那些可能没有听到这个信息、本会在选举前一周投票的人，也许邮局就无法及时将选票送达以使他们的选票有效。

sentences.en: I think there's a good chance now that they will get that ballot in ahead of time and their vote will count.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在他们很有可能会提前把选票寄到，并且他们的选票会有效。

sentences.en: Well, Luke, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，卢克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, under growing pressure from Democrats, activists and voters,
sentences.zh: 周二，在来自民主党人、活动人士和选民的越来越大的压力下，

sentences.en: Postmaster General DeJoy said he would formally suspend the operational changes he's been making to the Postal Service until after the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 邮政局长德乔伊表示，他将正式暂停他对邮政服务进行的操作性变更，直到 2020 年大选结束。

sentences.en: Among the changes he will suspend are eliminating overtime for mail carriers, reducing post office hours and removing postal boxes,
sentences.zh: 他将暂停的变更包括取消信件投递员的加班费、减少邮局营业时间和移除邮筒，

sentences.en: all of which have been blamed for slowing mail delivery and could undermine mail-in voting.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都被指责减缓了邮件投递，并可能破坏邮寄投票。

sentences.en: But DeJoy has not said that he will permanently reverse any of the changes that he has already made.
sentences.zh: 但德乔伊并未表示他将永久撤销他已经做出的任何更改。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: The Commonwealth of Kentucky cast all 60 votes for the next president of the United States, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州将全部 60 票投给了美国下一任总统乔·拜登。

sentences.en: Mississippi cast two votes for Bernie Sanders and 38 votes for our next president, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 密西西比州为伯尼·桑德斯投了两票，为我们的下一任总统乔·拜登投了 38 票。

sentences.en: Delaware is proud to cast its 32 votes for our favorite son and our next president, our friend, Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 特拉华州很荣幸将其 32 票投给我们最喜爱的本土子弟、我们的下一任总统、我们的朋友乔·拜登。

sentences.en: During the second night of the Democratic National Convention, after a virtual roll call from 57 states and U.S.
sentences.zh: 在民主党全国代表大会的第二个晚上，在对 57 个州和美国领土进行虚拟唱名表决后，

sentences.en: territories, Joe Biden was formally designated as the party's nominee for president.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登被正式确认为该党总统候选人。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very, very much from the bottom of my heart.
sentences.zh: 嗯，发自内心地非常非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you all.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: It means the world to me and my family.
sentences.zh: 这对我和我的家人意义重大。

sentences.en: And I'll see you on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我们周四见。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Later in the evening, Biden's wife, Dr. Jill Biden, delivered the night's keynote speech from a classroom quieted by the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 当晚晚些时候，拜登的妻子吉尔·拜登博士在因大流行而安静下来的教室里发表了当晚的主旨演讲。

sentences.en: Recalling her decision to marry Biden, not long after the death of his first wife and daughter in a car crash.
sentences.zh: 她回忆了自己决定嫁给拜登的经历，那是在他的第一任妻子和女儿在车祸中丧生不久之后。

sentences.en: I never imagined at the age of 26, I would be asking myself, how do you make a broken family whole?
sentences.zh: 我从未想过在 26 岁的时候，我会问自己：你如何让一个破碎的家庭重新完整？

sentences.en: Still, Joe always told the boys, mommy sent Jill to us.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，乔总是对男孩们说，妈妈把吉尔派给了我们。

sentences.en: And how could I argue with her?
sentences.zh: 我怎么能反驳她呢？

sentences.en: Recounting that tragedy, Jill Biden described her husband as uniquely capable of healing the nation in the middle of a deadly pandemic and economic collapse.
sentences.zh: 吉尔·拜登在重述那场悲剧时，将她的丈夫描述为在致命大流行和经济崩溃之中独具治愈国家能力的人。

sentences.en: I know that if we entrust this nation to Joe, he will do for your family what he did for ours.
sentences.zh: 我知道，如果我们把这个国家托付给乔，他会为你做他为我们家庭所做的事。

sentences.en: Bring us together and make us whole.
sentences.zh: 把我们凝聚在一起，让我们完整。

sentences.en: Carry us forward in our time of need.
sentences.zh: 在我们需要的时刻引领我们前行。

sentences.en: Keep the promise of America for all of us.
sentences.zh: 为我们所有人守护美国的承诺。

sentences.en: The speech was the latest sign that the Biden campaign will frame the coming election as a referendum on President Trump and his handling of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 这篇演讲是拜登竞选团队将即将到来的选举定性为对特朗普总统及其应对冠状病毒表现的全民公决的最新迹象。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又惊心动魄的争斗中。
